props.name: ariaDescribedBy
props.description:
Aria described by
- Used to connect the field note in select to the select menu for accessibility

props.name: fieldId
props.description: The unique id of the field

props.name: hideLabel
props.description:
Hide label?
- If true, hides the label from displaying

props.name: lowerRangeValue
props.description: Input value for lower range of range

props.name: name
props.description:
Name attribute forwarded to the underlying `<input type="range">`.
- Previously hardcoded to `"range"`, which silently overrode whatever the
  consumer submitted the field as.

props.name: upperRangeValue
props.description: Input value for upper range of range

events.name: onRangeDrag
events.description: Fired continuously while the thumb is dragged. Prefer `onRangeOutputValueChange` for committed values; this one fires on every move.

events.name: onRangeOutputValueChange
events.description: Fired when the range's output value changes. Detail: `{ value }`.

slots.name: after
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will override the default range "max" label text

slots.name: before
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will override the default range "min" label text

slots.name: label
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will override the default range label
